changelog:
New features:
Added an option to attach images in the chat dialog, choose any image from your computer and have your AI describe it for you. You can also ask follow-up questions in the same chat.
Added a hotkey to describe the currently focused window, useful for describing errors / inaccessible content. By default, the shortcut is NVDA+Alt+D and can be changed from Settings > Input Gestures.
When using Groq, qwen/qwen3.6-27b model will always be used for describing images regardless of whatever is configured in the settings.
Improvements:
Fixed response streaming when using Gemini.
